metadata.prompt: Re-render the supplied image with cinematic film lighting and professional color grading. Establish clear lighting hierarchy: a motivated directional key light, soft natural fill, and subtle rim/edge backlight separating subjects from the background. Apply a rich filmic contrast curve with warm skin-tone highlights and deep cool shadow roll-off. Enhance volume and depth using volumetric light haze and atmospheric depth cues. Preserve the exact identity, facial features, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, materials, color grading and art style of the supplied image. Do not alter poses, composition, character identities or background architecture. Do not add text, captions, watermarks, logos or frame borders.
